```{python}
#| label: setup
from paperfigs import data, fig_cost_convergence, fig_method_comparison

iterations = data.load_iterations()
runs = data.load_runs()
SST_RUNS = ["run25", "run26", "run30"]

sst = runs[runs["run"].isin(SST_RUNS) & runs["feasible"]]
best = sst.loc[sst["best_cost_usd_per_tCO2"].idxmin()]
best_cost = f"{best['best_cost_usd_per_tCO2']:.1f}"
```

## Key result

The SST agent autonomously reached **`{python} best_cost` \$/tCO~2~**
(purity ≥ 0.95, recovery ≥ 0.90), discovering multi-stage cascades
without a predefined superstructure.

## Convergence

```{python}
#| label: fig-convergence-slide

```
